def transform(grid):
    """Fill the interiors of rectangular outline components by parity."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            # Find this 4-connected component of one outline color.
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in comp), max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in comp), max(x for y,x in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Only a complete rectangular frame encloses an area.
            if not (all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 == 1 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == bg:
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
